bowl_config.storage_engine: StoreActor per disk (Pebble + 128 MiB 共享缓存 + 双缓冲 MPSC Group Commit + 16B BlobRef)
bowl_config.blob_layout: packs/pack-<id>.pack (64 MiB Append-Only Pack + 256 KiB 块网格 + 64 MiB 分片热块缓存 + ExtendTail)
bowl_config.wal_sync_mode: pebble.NoSync Group Commit + Fsync/FsyncDir 双层并行落盘屏障 (fdatasync + LogData)
bowl_config.concurrency_model: 单盘独立 StoreActor 串行 Phase A 内存校验 + WriterEpoch 世代号栅栏 + 无锁并发 Read

cache_prepare.drop_caches_command: sync; echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; ssh -n -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -i /root/.ssh/id_rsa root@172.16.1.199 'sync && echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches'
